claims.claim: Ploid's founder tweeted on 2026-10-28 that the company has indexed over 2 billion people and offers access to humans and AI agents for a few cents per profile.
Ploid prices credits at $0.20 (Growth, $200/mo, 1,000 credits) and $0.15 (Scale, $600/mo, 4,000 credits); per-action credit costs are not published.
Ploid's privacy policy does not mention data broker registration, gives no response deadline, and handles deletion by email.
ZoomInfo FY2025 revenue was $1,249.5M vs $1,214.3M in 2024; net revenue retention 90%.
Clay raised $115M Series D at $7.1B in September 2026; Sacra estimates $150M ARR in May 2026.
hiQ v. LinkedIn: Ninth Circuit held CFAA did not bar scraping public profiles, but hiQ lost on contract and settled for $500,000 plus a permanent injunction in December 2022.
Meta v. Bright Data (Jan 2024): logged-off scraping of public data was not 'use' under Meta's terms; narrow ruling.
Proxycurl shut down July 2025 after LinkedIn sued; LinkedIn sued ProAPIs in October 2025.
Dutch DPA fined Clearview EUR 30.5M in September 2024 for scraped biometric database incl. Article 14 transparency failures.
CNIL fined Kaspr EUR 240,000 on 2024-12-05 for collecting LinkedIn contact details including those users had restricted.
California DROP launched January 2026; brokers had to process requests from August 1, 2026; CalPrivacy fined Cybba $52,400 on 2026-08-13.
CPPA settled with B2B lead vendors Growbots ($35,400) and UpLead ($34,400) in Nov 2024 for failure to register as data brokers.
CFPB withdrew its proposed FCRA data-broker rule on 2025-05-15.
NJ Supreme Court held Daniel's Law has no mens rea requirement on 2026-08-12; Third Circuit constitutional ruling pending.
PeopleSearchBench (LessieAI, 2026-03-31) scored Lessie 65.2, Exa 55.0, Claude Code 46.0, Juicebox 45.8; authors own one evaluated platform.
Spokeo agreed to a $10M right-of-publicity settlement in 2026 after class certification of ~275,000 Californians and Ohioans.
CCPA 'publicly available' exclusion expanded by CPRA to information the consumer or widely distributed media made public.
